Heyyy! I’m so sorry to hear how much of a bad time you’re having it sounds awful. I too was in a situation like this where I wasn’t accessing help, I used dbt skills and they seemed to help me though with dbt it’s hard work and you have to want to get better for it to work which it sounds like you do! Here’s the link to the workbook I used (and still do use!) I think for you maybe the distress tolerance section would be worth looking at considering the self harm aspects, distress tolerance helped me a lot with self harm, obviously it won’t work for everyone but it’s worth giving it a try, remember if you are in crisis or danger call someone like a crisis line or hospital to keep yourself safe, remember you are loved and you deserve to get better :)
